summary: `bm.room(name)` opens one WebSocket per room, joins it and keeps it joined. A dropped socket (app restart, `benmore env set`, push of an encrypted-field change, restore, refresh-dev, or the server's heartbeat close after sign-out or a tenant switch) reconnects and joins the room again.
reconnect: Jittered exponential backoff: 0.5 s doubling up to a 30 s ceiling, each delay between half and all of its step. A connection that stayed open 10 s starts the backoff over; one that drops at once keeps growing it, so an accept-then-close loop cannot spin. When a handshake fails before opening, the SDK sends one plain `GET /ws` (browsers hide the WebSocket's HTTP status): 401 (signed out in an app with an auth: block) or 403 (cross-origin) closes the room for good; 400 (the upgrade would be admitted), 429, 5xx and network errors are retried.

events.bm:status: {state:'open'} after connect and join; {state:'open', reconnected:true} after a reconnect; {state:'reconnecting', attempt, retryIn (ms), code (socket close code), http? (the GET /ws answer after a failed handshake)}; {state:'closed', reason:'left'|'refused'|'unauthorized'|'forbidden', unsent?: <queued messages never sent>}.
events.bm:error: {code:'not_member'|'too_many_rooms'|'join_refused'|'unauthorized'|'forbidden', message, room}. The server's {type:'error', room, body:'not a member of this room'} (ws_rooms) arrives here, and the room then closes without reconnecting: retrying cannot change a membership answer.
events.delivery: Both reach on(kind, fn) and onAny(fn) with from === null; peers' frames never carry null (a user id, 'server', or no from for an anonymous sender). The names are namespaced so a payload kind an app already uses ('status', 'error') is not mixed with them.

send: room.send(payload) returns true when written to the open socket and false when queued: while connecting or reconnecting, up to 16 messages wait and go out in order right after the next join (16 stays under the server's 20 frames per second per connection). The payload is serialized when send() is called. A 17th queued send throws (err.code 'room_queue_full'), and any send after the room closed throws (err.code 'room_closed'); nothing is dropped without an error. leave() discards the queue and reports the count as unsent.
not_replayed: Room messages are not stored: anything peers or `run: broadcast` sent while the socket was down is gone. On {state:'open', reconnected:true}, refetch whatever durable state the page shows (messages table, presence list).
session: The socket carries the session it opened with. When bm.auth changes the page's session (sign-in, sign-out, tenant switch, act-as), every room the app has not left opens a fresh socket, as bm.live does; a room closed by a refusal gets another try with the new identity. Open the room again with bm.room(name) after leave().
state: room.state is 'connecting' | 'open' | 'reconnecting' | 'closed'. room.raw is the current WebSocket and changes on reconnect; handlers set on it directly do not carry over.
